_comment: Deterministic settings the plugin safety harness renders blackjack with. random_seed pins the shoe so the same cards are dealt on every run; without it the plugin uses system entropy and no two renders match, which is the point of the plugin and the enemy of a golden image. The harness renders one frame per mode, which lands during the opening pause -- so what it proves is that the table chrome, the seat markers and the layout survive every panel shape, and the per-beat coverage lives in test_blackjack_render.py instead.
